title: Replace finding-registry temporary identity types after clause IR lands
description: After PR #475 lands, replace the local obligation and EvidenceKind declarations in the finding registry with the shared clause-IR types. Preserve the serialized obligationId format and all six evidence-kind spellings; keep this cleanup separate from prose-scoped membership derivation.
acceptance_criteria: The registry imports the shared clause-IR identity/evidence types without changing serialized data or validator behavior.
